type.title: Post type
type.intro: Choose who publishes. This cannot be changed later.

content.title: Title and description
content.intro: Say who you are or what the server offers.

positions.title: Roles
positions.intro: Pick the roles, or "Other" to write your own.

extras.title: Theme, tags and expiry
extras.intro: Helps sort and find the post. Optional.

review.title: Review and send
review.intro: Check before sending. A published post shows in the feed right away.

locked.hiddenBody: The Moddy team has hidden this post. It can no longer be edited.
locked.forbiddenBody: Only the author of a personal post and the managers of the server can edit a post.

guild.title: A server is hiring
guild.hint: For a server you manage that has a Lineup profile.

user.title: Offer my services
user.hint: A post in your name, to find a team.

bot.title: A bot is hiring
bot.hint: For a bot whose support server you administer and that has a Lineup profile.

noGuilds.title: No managed server
noGuilds.body: You need to manage a Discord server and claim it on Lineup to post in its name. You can also publish a personal post.

type.locked: The type and the author cannot change once the post exists.

noBots.title: No bots managed
noBots.body: Add to Lineup a bot whose support server you administer to post in its name.

botsStale.title: Could not check your servers
botsStale.body: Discord did not answer. Try again in a moment.

positions.otherHint: One name per role, {{max}} characters at most.

requirements.noValue: This requirement has no value to enter.
requirements.verifiedHint: Lineup does not check anything yet: the post only states that a check is planned.

application.noneHint: Without one, the post has no "Apply" button.
application.dmHint: Interested people message the author of the post on Discord.

extras.themeNsfw: NSFW posts are left out of the feed unless people ask for them.
extras.tagsHint: Up to {{max}}. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 24 characters.
extras.expiryNever: Never by default. Otherwise between {{min}} and {{max}}.
extras.expiryRange: Between {{min}} and {{max}}. The post expires at the end of that day.

review.quotaFull: You are at your limit: close a post or save this one as a draft.

banner.quotaNew: A draft does not count toward the limit. You can publish it when a slot frees up.
banner.quotaEdit: Your changes are saved, but the post is not published. Close a post, then publish it from My posts.

validation.guildNotClaimed: This server is not claimed on Lineup.
validation.otherRequired: Write at least one name for "Other".
validation.formUnavailable: The Lineup form is not available yet.
validation.urlHttps: Enter an https address, without credentials or spaces.
validation.timezone: Use an IANA name (Europe/Paris) or UTC+02:00.
validation.tag: 2 to 24 characters: lower case, digits, hyphens.
validation.featuredUserOnly: Only a personal post can feature an experience.
validation.botNotManaged: You do not manage this bot.
